reviews.text: I would say it was an excellent solution, everything was clean and the manager was very helpful and available.
Thank you 🙏 …
The groomer is excellent and loves dogs, and vice versa. The self-catering area is also always very well kept.
Kind, professional, very friendly

First time at this shop
3-year-old Maltese groomer, satisfied. Professional and friendly. Reasonable price. Would definitely return.
Very kind and professional people. My cat and my dog ​​are happy when I bring them there, and this always puts my mind at ease. Excellent service.
Very good
Always good and patient with my Irish setter
A welcoming, clean, and professional place, ideal for washing your pets with care but without stress. The most popular accessory is the dedicated washing machine for your pets, perfect.
Excellent service

Good morning, I've been taking my Maggie for a wash and shearing for a few years now, and I've always had a great experience.
The staff is efficient and friendly, and always willing to help me find a solution so I can bring Maggie along without any problems. The shop is always clean and smells good, and when I'm late, I find my Maggie waiting for me with her treat in a dedicated area.
Thank you for your attention, you're one of a kind.
Maria Teresa Forlano

I only brought my Shiba Inu here once, and I noticed the man was holding him down too tightly to trim his nails. My dog ​​cried, but I didn't say anything because I thought my Shiba was just being dramatic (like all Shibas). Then I discovered his nails were bleeding. Since then, he hasn't let me touch his paws. I've never had this problem before: my dog ​​has been accustomed to being groomed since he was a puppy. I don't recommend it.
Kind, professional, and above all, animal lovers. They always treat my Orsola with care and love... and, of course, top-notch grooming! Highly recommended.
Kind and fast, they take care of our dog in a professional and affectionate way, recommended!
Clean place and very professional staff

Mr. Andrea was exceptional. We brought our puppy for the first time and he was very nervous. He was able to put him at ease with his kindness and patience. Our dog came out with a very soft and fragrant coat. Thank you, Andrea, for your help!
It's truly delightful; the dog is comfortable and not scared. The owner is a truly loving person with dogs. Tippy felt truly pampered. I highly recommend it.

I took my dog ​​to the groomer for the first time with a bit of fear that she might get scared.
Andrea was able to read her signals right away, respect her pace, and guide her calmly and sensitively throughout the experience. He put her at ease with an attentive, competent, and truly dog-centered approach.
I really appreciated his ability to read the dog and his mindful management of emotions: not just impeccable aesthetic care, but genuine attention to the animal's needs.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a groomer that puts their dog's well-being first. I'm truly in good hands with him!

A truly positive experience! The Wash Dog Milano San Siro store is new, spotlessly clean, and impeccably kept.

I was impressed by the professionalism and kindness with which we were welcomed: you immediately sense the customer care and love for animals.

The store features a wealth of high-quality products, carefully selected and organized. It's rare to find such a refined yet welcoming environment.

For those like me who often visit #Boscoincittà and return home with a dog in a terrible state, this place is truly a lifesaver!

I highly recommend it to everyone: five stars in every way.

Groomer on Via Novato. I have a dog with a really difficult temperament, and today I took him to the groomer on Via Novara for the third time. The groomer was excellent, sweet, thorough, and infinitely patient. I won't change again!! Thank you so much.

A very positive experience and impeccable service. My dog ​​was treated with extreme care and kindness. Perfect grooming, kind and professional staff. I recommend this shop to anyone looking for quality service and people who truly love animals! I'll definitely be back!
Thanks Laura 👍 …
Kindness, courtesy, cleanliness, and professionalism. Excellent access with a ramp for large dogs.
A truly useful service for anyone looking for simple and professional pet care. I'll definitely be back!

Professional service, qualified staff attentive to customer needs.
Very clean and well-kept environment. Precise and high-quality dog ​​grooming and cutting.

Today was our first visit, and we brought our Mia. The owner and staff were professional and attentive, and helpful.
We are absolutely satisfied and will gladly return, recommending it to everyone.
Thanks Sara for the 5 stars!!

Passing through the area we happened to notice this 24-hour do-it-yourself dog grooming and washing service. During the week they also do your dog grooming if you don't have time. The owner, a really kind person, welcomed us and explained to us in a very thorough way how to use the service offered by the shop. It's really well-kept, tidy, clean and safe. Being 24 hours a day there are also cameras. Highly recommended. We really enjoyed washing our 4-legged friend!

I brought my dog ​​here for the first time today through word of mouth. We had a complete grooming session... a very pleasant surprise!
We'll definitely be back in the future. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

I don't usually write reviews, but this one is definitely worth it. The staff is highly qualified, loving, patient, and reassuring, even with us "inexperienced and young" owners. The shop is super clean and well-organized. They offer many services, beyond grooming. Five stars aren't enough; the whole firmament is needed!
Brio and I will be back soon!

We stopped in to inquire about the services they offered, as it was recently opened and close to our home.

The shop is modern, well-maintained, and clean. Marialuisa welcomed us immediately with kindness and professionalism, explaining the stalls where you can bathe your pet yourself. The space is well-equipped, convenient, and intuitive, even for those who aren't very experienced, like us!

We returned today to take advantage of the professionalism of the staff in charge of bathing our pet. My dog ​​was very scared at the thought of bathing, but the groomer managed to calm him down and make him feel safe! The washing, drying, grooming, and professionalism were all completely fulfilled!

You can tell they love animals and know how to treat them in the best possible way.

The girls were very kind and friendly, despite the many questions we asked! The price was average. Highly recommended!

I brought my cocker spaniel Blue and they were truly exceptional. They washed him, pampered him, and dried him impeccably. When I went to pick him up, I was so happy!
I must emphasize their skill in trimming a cocker spaniel's coat. It's not easy to do this for a long-haired dog... they were exceptional! If I could give them 10 stars, I would! Highly recommended.

Wonderful place. I took my cat to get his fur trimmed. It was my first time there. Everyone was wonderful, so attentive to my baby. I was able to stay inside with him because it was my first time. They were truly fantastic. Ms. Bibiana was truly professional and attentive. Now my daughter will go there with her cat. They are truly reliable and professional. I will gladly return. Thank you so much.

Truly comfortable and ergonomic facility. The owners are very kind and provide thorough explanations. Washing is self-service or entrusted to their groomers; each stall is fully equipped and everything works perfectly. There's also a washer and dryer for blankets and beds. In short, it's a blessing to have them close to home. I highly recommend it.

Professionalism and a close bond with the dog, right from the first wash and grooming of our Irish setter. That's no small feat for our red superhero! Highly recommended if you're in and around San Siro.
Our beloved Thor left the center happy, clean, and beautiful. The staff were super kind and professional, we'll always be back!
Friendly owners

I tried both the self-dog wash and the grooming. We have two Maltese dogs, and about 10 days ago I took them in for grooming in pretty dire conditions, one of them in particular having knots. I found attention, care, and professionalism. Our puppies were beautiful and, most importantly, managed to maintain their hair length despite the knots. We will definitely be back as soon as possible.

After a walk in the Quarry Park, Stella rolled around in the manure, making herself dirty and smelling awful. Luckily, Marialuisa helped me right away, welcoming us into her shop with extreme professionalism and kindness.
She cleaned her, washed her, and made her beautiful and smelling fresh, ready for the holidays.
Thanks again for your kindness and availability.
We'll get a subscription now. Happy holidays to everyone.

Excellent service!
It was a truly wonderful discovery!
It has everything you need to wash and dry them!
I absolutely recommend it.

We signed up for Wash Dog San Siro in March 2024, and we immediately sensed their passion and kindness. But I'd like to tell you my story because there are things that make a difference. Today I showed up alone with my dog ​​(42 kg) and I had forgotten my card for a self-wash. Martina, my dog ​​and companion, was welcomed like a queen. No one left me alone; the entire team helped me, making Martina feel at ease. At the end, after washing and drying, they even gave her a paw treatment. I just want to say that anyone can have a grooming center, but people are priceless. How much did I pay? Try it and you'll understand. 10 isn't enough. Guys, keep it up, you're great. Martina said she'll be back.

Don't miss out on having your dog washed or clipped at this shop, because you might regret it!
The staff is super friendly and welcoming, and above all, COMPETENT!
Not to mention the aesthetics and cleanliness of the place.
Top notch!
See you soon ❤️ my Kiki can't wait to come back! Thank you so much!
Thank you 🙏 …
Very good and very professional!

Today I took my toy poodle to the groomer. The service was wonderful! My poodle, traumatized by a previous negative experience, was greeted with extreme kindness and expertise and, for the first time, left feeling calm.

Aside from the problem of the mandatory top-up since I have a Riccione card, I don't blame the manager or the employees, but the franchise! Everything was perfect! Maria Luisa's welcome and assistance were excellent! My papillon's grooming …
Fantastic! First time with them. They returned our beloved "sheepskin" washed, combed (without even a single knot), and smelling just like a glove! Highly recommended. …

I brought my poodle and was extremely satisfied with the service I received. From the very first moment, the staff was welcoming and professional, and demonstrated great expertise and attention to detail.
The end result was exceptional!
The dog was clipped very badly
Beautiful 24h wash
